Just seeing this video today but yes people, especially in Southern California buy properties and cars and lease and sublease a lease. Seen it and waa dumb enough to get involved in a situation like thar. Someone gets screwed the longer the chain of custody gets.  But its an image thing. LA is full of suckers trying to come up in the worse way. When getting involved in repo you'll see people still buying more while owing a lot in other places. A middle leaser is the worse as they usually have less to lose and will burn a bridge.  

If its a house the main thing to look for is the "live in factor". Does the house look lived in, pictures and memories.  Also furniture,  is it staged or rental.  Location. Why live on a golf course but don't golf.  You have a slip but no boat? Signs and common sense on your part to identify the con.
